channel.title: Remote Yoga Coach, Blog
channel.description: Practical wellbeing for distributed teams: burnout prevention, workplace mindfulness, chair yoga and honest advice on corporate wellbeing that gets used.

item.title: Kontorsyoga på distans: vad det är och hur det funkar för svenska team
item.description: Vad är stolyoga eller kontorsyoga på distans egentligen, och hur går det till i praktiken via Teams eller Zoom? En enkel förklaring för team som är nyfikna men osäkra.

item.title: Hybridarbete och psykisk hälsa: så håller du teamet friskt på distans
item.description: Tidiga tecken på att ett hybrid- eller distansteam börjar gå på knäna, varför punktinsatser sällan hjälper, och en enkel återkommande vana som faktiskt gör skillnad.

item.title: Räknas digital yoga och mindfulness som friskvårdsbidrag för distansteam?
item.description: Kan friskvårdsbidraget användas till återkommande yoga- och mindfulnesspass för ett distansarbetande team? Så funkar reglerna i korthet, och hur ni bokar rätt.

item.title: Corporate wellness ideas that actually work for remote and hybrid teams
item.description: Most remote wellness ideas lists are full of things nobody does twice. What actually drives participation for distributed teams, and how to tell the difference.

item.title: How to improve team morale on a remote team
item.description: What actually lifts morale on a distributed team: being seen as a person, shared rituals, realistic workloads and honest recognition, not forced fun or perks.

item.title: How to start a corporate wellbeing programme: a practical guide for HR
item.description: A practical, step-by-step guide to starting a corporate wellbeing programme from scratch. How to set up an employee wellbeing programme that people actually use, built on one consistent habit rather than a scattering of perks.

item.title: Corporate wellbeing for tech teams
item.description: Tech and startup teams burn out quietly long before anyone says so. Here is why builder culture is prone to it, and what a recurring live reset actually changes.

item.title: Tech neck: gentle exercises to undo desk and screen posture
item.description: What tech neck really is, why it builds up over a desk day, and gentle seated exercises to release your neck, shoulders and upper back. No equipment needed.

item.title: Office yoga for remote and hybrid teams: what it actually is
item.description: Office yoga and workplace yoga are umbrella terms for yoga done during the workday, wherever your team sits. Here is what a live, on-screen session actually looks like.

item.title: Neck and shoulder stretches for desk workers (that actually help)
item.description: Six neck and shoulder stretches you can do at your desk to ease the tension that builds from a day at the screen. No equipment, takes three minutes.

item.title: How to keep a hybrid team focused and connected
item.description: Hybrid teams lose focus and connection in the gaps between office and home. Here are practical habits a manager can put in place, and one shared weekly anchor that reaches everyone equally.

item.title: How to meditate at work: a simple practice you can do at your desk
item.description: A practical guide to meditation at work: a short, no-equipment desk meditation you can do between meetings, plus how to get past the two obstacles that stop most people.

item.title: Building a strong, connected remote team (beyond perks)
item.description: Swag and one-off socials do not build a strong remote team. Here is what actually creates connection and belonging on a distributed team, and how a recurring live wellbeing session helps.

item.title: A 5-minute meditation you can do at your desk (camera off)
item.description: A simple 5-minute desk meditation for the gap between meetings, no app, no cushion, camera off. Reset your focus and steady your stress in five minutes flat.

item.title: Do workplace wellness apps actually work? What the engagement data says
item.description: Wellbeing apps look like an easy win, but the engagement numbers tell a harder story. What the data shows, and what works better for distributed teams.

item.title: Breathing exercises for work stress: 4 techniques for your next meeting
item.description: Four simple breathing exercises you can do at your desk, before a meeting, a presentation or a difficult call, to steady your nerves in under two minutes.

item.title: How to run a wellbeing session over Teams (or Zoom)
item.description: A practical guide to running a virtual wellbeing session for a remote team over Teams or Zoom: setup, the session arc, getting people to show up, and the norms that make it work.

item.title: Team wellbeing subscription vs one-off workshops: which actually works?
item.description: One-off wellbeing workshops feel efficient but fade fast. Here is how a team wellbeing subscription compares on results and cost, and when a one-off still makes sense.

item.title: Corporate mindfulness sessions: what to actually expect
item.description: What a corporate mindfulness session actually involves, what happens in one, how often to run them, and how to tell if it is working. A plain guide for HR and people leaders.

item.title: How to prevent burnout in a distributed team
item.description: Burnout hides in distributed teams. How to recognise the warning signs remotely, what does not work, and the preventive habits that actually help, for managers and HR.

item.title: Desk yoga for office workers: a 5-minute routine between calls
item.description: A 5-minute desk yoga routine for the gap between calls, no equipment, no changing, camera off. Reset your body and focus between back-to-back meetings.

item.title: Chair yoga at your desk: 8 poses for office workers (no mat, no changing)
item.description: 8 simple chair yoga poses you can do at your desk, no mat, no changing, no looking odd in the office. A 5-minute reset for tense shoulders and a stiff back.

item.title: How much does corporate yoga actually cost? A 2026 guide for UK and European teams
item.description: What corporate yoga really costs in 2026, per session, per month and per employee, for UK and European teams, plus how online pricing compares.
